BlitzLLVM is a BlitzBasic (Blitz2D, Blitz3D, BlitzPlus) compiler built on the LLVM compiler backend. It turns a `.bb` program into one self-contained executable.

* [[Building]]: compile BlitzLLVM from source on Windows, Linux and macOS.
* [[Installation]]: install a nightly build or your own build, and compile your first program.
* [[Releasing]]: publish a release from a version tag.
* [[Environment-Variables]]: the `BLITZLLVM_` variables that change what programs and tools do.
* [[Warnings]]: the `-W` options of `blitzcc`, the warning levels and `-Werror`.
* [[blitz-format]]: format `.bb` source code with a style that a `.blitz-format` file sets.
* [[Differences]]: where BlitzLLVM behaves differently from the original Blitz3D and BlitzPlus.

## Command reference

* [[Language]]: variables, operators, control flow, functions, arrays, types and data.
* [[Command-Index]]: every command from A to Z.
* [[Language-Features]]: control flow, functions, loops, types, keywords, math, strings, random numbers and time.
* [[BlitzBasic]]: what all three dialects share, such as files, 2D graphics, input and audio.
* [[Blitz3D]]: entities, cameras, lights, meshes, textures, collisions and the rest of the 3D world.
* [[BlitzPlus]]: windows, gadgets, events and system access.

The README in the repository lists the supported commands and the compiler options.
